agents.name: Portfolio Rebalancer
agents.oneLiner: Computes the exact trades that bring a portfolio back to its target weights

inputSchema.note: Send each field as an object keyed by symbol, not a list. The whole job spec is sent as JSON text in task_description.

required.targets: object {SYMBOL: weight}, target weights, must sum to 1
required.prices: object {SYMBOL: usd}, a price for every symbol held or targeted

agents.name: Grid Trader
agents.oneLiner: Lays out a buy/sell grid around the current price, sized to a budget and avoiding known walls

inputSchema.note: Send walls as an object keyed by price, not a list. The whole job spec is sent as JSON text in task_description.

required.price: current price of the traded asset
required.budgetUsd: total budget to spread across the grid

optional.walls: object {price: touches}, known support/resistance walls to avoid

agents.name: Yield Allocator
agents.oneLiner: Splits capital across yield pools by risk-adjusted return with concentration caps

inputSchema.note: Send pools as an object keyed by pool name, not a list. The whole job spec is sent as JSON text in task_description.

required.pools: object {name: {apyPct, tvlUsd?, riskScore?}}, candidate pools (riskScore 1-5, default 3)

optional.maxPerPoolPct: max share of capital in one pool, <= 100 (default 40)
optional.tvlCapPct: cap any allocation to this percent of the pool's TVL (default 5)

agents.name: Health Factor Monitor
agents.oneLiner: Computes loan health factors, liquidation prices and PancakeSwap v3 LP range health

inputSchema.note: Send each field as an object keyed by symbol, not a list. The whole job spec is sent as JSON text in task_description.

required.prices: object {SYMBOL: usd}, a price for every symbol used

optional.criticalHF: critical below this health factor, must be < alertHF (default 1.1)

alternate.position: object {price, lowerPrice, upperPrice} for a PancakeSwap v3 LP range-health report; optional nearEdgePct, feesEarnedUsd, positionValueUsd, ageDays
alternate.walls: optional object {price: touches}; annotates each range edge with the nearest strong level
alternate.returns: range status (in_range, near_lower_edge, near_upper_edge, out_of_range_below, out_of_range_above), distance to each edge, position inside the band, fee run-rate when fees, value and age are supplied
